name: MangaTranslate
description: Translates manga pages and PDFs through a credit-metered REST API: OCR, text removal, background repair and typesetting, submitted as tasks and polled for translated image URLs.

skills.name: Submit Translation
skills.description: Submits a manga page or PDF to POST /api/v1/api/translate with a source and target language, returning a task for the translation job.

skills.name: Task Status
skills.description: Polls GET /api/v1/api/tasks/{id} for job state and the resulting translated image URLs once processing finishes.

skills.name: Credit Balance
skills.description: Reads the remaining credit balance via GET /api/v1/api/credits before queuing billable translation work.
